# EcoValue Forum

> EcoValue Forum is a community for leaders at Israeli-founded companies working in waste-to-value, environmental businesses and technologies. The Forum is focused on commercial growth, scale, shared learning and connections between peers.

## About

EcoValue Forum brings together leaders at Israeli-founded businesses to share experience, learn from peers, explore opportunities and support each other's growth.

The Forum is built around the understanding that real growth and scale in environmental businesses and technologies requires a compelling commercial case.

## Initial Focus

EcoValue's initial focus is Waste-to-Value (W2V), including:

- Waste-to-value technologies
- Resource recovery
- Recycling and advanced materials
- Energy recovery
- Circular economy
- Environmental technology
- Commercialization and market adoption
- Policy and market mechanisms

The community can expand over time into the broader environmental technology and services ecosystem.

## Community

The Forum is intended for leaders at Israeli-founded companies, including entrepreneurs, operators, commercial leaders and technology developers, as well as relevant industry, investment, research and policy stakeholders.
